feature: Native attitude instrument and unavailable state
toolbox: ATT/AHR modules draw a native horizon from converted Ptch/Roll; telemetry loss dims the instrument.
aerodeck: Cockpit draws native drawHudRectangle plus original bitmap bezel; missing current Pitch/Roll shows ATTITUDE UNAVAILABLE. Executable path exists.
consequence: The instrument feature exists. This does not establish responsive telemetry on hardware.
ux: Keep the original cockpit and explicit unavailable overlay; compare physical orientation with Toolbox.

feature: Consistent attitude response on the same radio
toolbox: User reports stable response on the same TX16S/link. Verified original loop includes disarmed MSP before normal telemetry and attitude drawing.
aerodeck: Installed read-only MSP client supplies the previously missing transaction path. Earlier standalone/main tests slowed despite20fps; no confirmed post-update hardware result.
consequence: The key performance requirement cannot be called complete from simulator FPS or source similarity.
ux: Release gate: compare complete installed AERODECK directly with Toolbox, same model/settings, beyond launch; do not substitute another isolated test.

toolbox: Dashboard combines attitude, speed/altitude, pack/link gauges and mode information.
aerodeck: Cockpit displays current speed/altitude tapes, LQ/RSSI, pack voltage/average/remaining/consumption, current and GPS course; unavailable values use dashes.
consequence: Core current-value cockpit instruments are implemented, with configured cell count and actual sensor availability limits.
ux: Retain composition and sharp assets; label cell average and GPS course accurately.

toolbox: Original MPN/SPN/BPN build independent capability-driven choices for main, side and bottom regions (AHR/BFV/BTC/FCD, ATT/CMP/GPS/POS, THR/MSP/MEM).
aerodeck: Fixed cockpit plus separate pages; no panel choice, saved cockpit layout or equivalent fast inline switch.
consequence: A page menu does not reproduce the dashboard configuration workflow.
ux: Expose optional information without redesigning the accepted cockpit; measure the number of actions needed.

toolbox: FC_FM/FC_FM_NAME appears in DB1/FM and telemetry table.
aerodeck: Mapped current FM text appears in the cockpit contextual tab and Telemetry table. It is not a command.
consequence: Basic reported flight mode is available; independent AUX modes are a separate missing feature.
ux: Keep flight-mode text distinct from selected radio flight mode and from FC armed proof.

toolbox: CFGIND supports physical switch positions and negations, logical switches1..64, and telemetry-related source options; INDUPD applies them.
aerodeck: Config supports SA..SH/L01..L04 and Low/Centre/High; read-only ON/OFF indications appear in Arm Stops footer. No invert/not-position/full logical range.
consequence: Some real models cannot express their existing arm/cut logic in AERODECK.
ux: Use an actual source picker with inversion and Unknown state; never equate radio switch ON with FC armed.

toolbox: CFGINDBF defines separate sources; INDUPD and FMI display simultaneous mode indicators.
aerodeck: BETAFLIGHT INDICATORS contains FM mapping and explanatory notes only. No independent configurable Air/Turtle/etc. states.
consequence: The configuration heading is not a functional replacement for Toolbox mode indicators.
ux: Show independent sourced chips and Unknown when unavailable; one FM string may not encode simultaneous AUX states.

toolbox: DB1/THR reads throttle and configured IND_THL source; shows throttle percent, THR CUT and limiter percent. CFGIND selects limiter source.
aerodeck: Cut indicator exists, but no throttle percentage, limiter configuration or gauge.
consequence: A useful readiness/launch check in Toolbox is absent.
ux: Group throttle, limiter and cut near readiness information; display only, no output changes.

feature: Current sensor table and complete browsing
toolbox: MOD/TLM builds its table from active protocol/category sensor records and supports scrolling beyond the visible grid.
aerodeck: Current table has27 fixed rows, plus separate five-row paged Sensor Inspector. Arbitrary discovered sensors do not join the main table.
consequence: Useful values exist, but full sensor browsing and table coverage differ.
ux: One browsable sensor list with units/status and pinned cockpit fields; no duplicate lists that disagree.

toolbox: Original MOD/TLM constructs LIVE/MIN/MAX; original TLMUPDS reads sourceID+1/+2 into min/max values.
aerodeck: No MIN/MAX reads or selector.90-sample app traces are a different feature, not native sensor extrema.
consequence: User cannot inspect minimum pack voltage or worst link/current values as in Toolbox.
ux: Visible Current/Min/Max selector, historical styling, reset scope; retain units and distinguish old extrema after link loss.

toolbox: Toolbox reads cached values and presents telemetry loss/dimming at link level; ordinary data and min/max paths are separate.
aerodeck: Main sampler checks getSourceValue current; unavailable values become nil/dashes. Inspector reports CURRENT or STALE/NONE. No synthetic substitution.
consequence: Core missing/current state handling is implemented; current flag is not a measured packet frequency.
ux: Use freshness age only where known; do not label redraw FPS as live telemetry rate.

feature: Qualified telemetry identity across all views
toolbox: Original TLMSADD binds getSourceIndex(CHAR_TELEMETRY..pName), avoiding named input collisions.
aerodeck: Full app qualifies bindings; Sensor Inspector and compact widget still use unqualified getFieldInfo(name).
consequence: Same-named radio inputs can make widget/inspector disagree with the full app.
ux: Share the qualified identity/mapping layer everywhere; verify same-name input versus telemetry collision.

toolbox: Protocol-specific GPS/BARO/PITOT/GYRO records preserve separate altitude/speed/attitude roles and units.
aerodeck: Converts radians/degrees, speed units and feet/metres; one alt field prefers GAlt then Alt, so GPS/baro are not independently mapped/displayed. Generic voltage/current mappings lack unit feedback.
consequence: One Alt slot cannot replace both GPS altitude and barometric altitude.
ux: Show source and real unit; separate GPS/barometric altitude and ground/air/vertical speed.

toolbox: MOD/GPS shows these fields and home details with explicit units.
aerodeck: GPS Details displays current coordinates, satellite count, ground speed, altitude and GPS course; validates coordinate bounds. Basic fields work without MSP satellite detail.
consequence: The common CRSF GPS values are present; additional fix/satellite fields are separate gaps.
ux: Keep DDEG precision readable and distinguish GPS course from magnetic/yaw heading.

toolbox: Original TBS/GPS line49 calls satellite-threshold result POS_FIX; line50 synthesizes HDOP from Sats-4. MOD/GPS labels3D FIX. This CRSF heuristic is not actual reported receiver fix/HDOP.
aerodeck: Explicit FIX TYPE NOT REPORTED; no fix or HDOP reader. Deliberately avoids inferring3D fix from count.
consequence: Visible parity differs, but copying Toolbox inferred labels would create false certainty.
ux: Use real reported fix/HDOP if acquired; otherwise preserve Not reported or explicitly label inferred quality.

toolbox: MOD/GPS enumerates SAT_TYPE/SAT_STAT and satellite records with used/status/signal plus scrolling; separate MSP path supplies them.
aerodeck: Only aggregate Sats; no satellite list, constellation, signal or health state.
consequence: The detailed left-hand Toolbox GPS pane is not implemented by showing a large Sats number.
ux: Conditional detailed list tied to an actual supported data path, with timestamp and count; no invented rows.

toolbox: Original TBS/GPS updates prospective home then locks POS_FIXH when fix+armed; computes home continuously in its telemetry callback.
aerodeck: Manual local home and opt-in first valid home above satellite threshold. No takeoff arm-lock or FC-home provenance; first capture occurs only when GPS/Nav renderer calls navSnapshot.
consequence: Home may be captured after the aircraft has moved if user remains on Flight.
ux: Explicit local/FC home provenance and capture/lock policy; maintain acquisition outside page drawing.

toolbox: GPS module calculates great-circle distance and home ground-course bearing.
aerodeck: geo() computes distance and absolute bearing; GPS Details and Track/Home display both when local home and current coordinates exist.
consequence: Geometry exists for the selected local home; this does not prove FC takeoff-home parity.
ux: Use Bearing to home label and explicit local-home source; never imply the FC home is read.

toolbox: TBS/GPS calculates DIR_RBH from current course and home course; DB1/GPS draws a relative home arrow and CMP compass.
aerodeck: North-up track and absolute bearing only; no relative home arrow/compass integration.
consequence: User cannot get the same glanceable return-home direction on the cockpit.
ux: Relative arrow only when usable current course is known; stationary GPS course must remain qualified.

toolbox: GPSINIT.calcTravelTime computes distance/speed; POS displays ETH hours/minutes/seconds.
aerodeck: No ETA/home travel-time calculation or control/display.
consequence: Toolbox recovery/navigation estimate is absent.
ux: Label estimate, with unavailable state for missing/near-zero speed; never treat as flight-endurance prediction.

toolbox: Position/home bookkeeping is a normal telemetry update callback; GPSINIT.addPosition keeps timestamped bounded records, optionally longer history.
aerodeck: navSnapshot and one-second track accumulation run only on GPS/Nav pages. Coordinates lack per-point timestamp; app/compact transitions discard local state.
consequence: Opening another page stops track acquisition; this is not a continuous flight history.
ux: Maintain bounded session data independent of page; expose last known location and age as historical on signal loss.

toolbox: BTV/BTA register RxBt/Curr/Capa/Bat% and display numeric/gauge values.
aerodeck: Mapped current values appear on Flight/Telemetry/Power; battery average is pack voltage/configured cell count.
consequence: Basic live flight-pack monitoring is implemented; cells and pack/session management are separate.
ux: Keep pack versus cell-average terminology explicit and values unavailable on stale inputs.

toolbox: Original FRS/BTV supports Cels array; DB1/BTC shows individual cell voltages when available.
aerodeck: No Cels array reader. CELL AVG is derived from pack/configured count.
consequence: A pack average cannot reveal one weak cell; availability depends on actual sensor/transport.
ux: Only show an individual-cell pane with measured array data; never synthesize equal cells from RxBt.

toolbox: BTCNO loops1..6 against max-cell voltage when no favorite selected; array sensor path can provide actual count.
aerodeck: Count0 means Not set and disables average/per-cell checks; manual fixed count or selected preset required.
consequence: The Toolbox config/auto sense option has no AERODECK runtime equivalent.
ux: Clearly choose Auto/Fixed and show inferred versus measured count; ambiguous packs need an explicit override.

toolbox: Five enabled favorites with chemistry, cell count and capacity; config/auto option separate.
aerodeck: Three presets with cell count/capacity plus Manual; no chemistry field or disabled-entry control.
consequence: Only part of the Toolbox pack configuration can be represented.
ux: Use named packs with cells/capacity/chemistry and active selection; preserve existing profiles on migration.

toolbox: Original BFV dashboard pane selects pack by rotary/ENTER and persists active favorite.
aerodeck: Active pack selection exists only inside general Battery Favorites settings; no cockpit/power quick picker.
consequence: Between-pack workflow requires deeper configuration instead of a fast selection action.
ux: One action from Power/cockpit opens connected-pack selector; show what selection changes before applying.

toolbox: TBS/BTA derives remaining from selected favorite capacity and consumed mAh, overriding when favorite active.
aerodeck: Derives bounded capacity-based percent only when Bat% absent; labels Est%/EST. REMAINING. Policy intentionally differs from Toolbox preference.
consequence: Estimate function exists, with full-pack/reset-consumption assumptions; no automatic new-pack detector was verified in Toolbox.
ux: Show reported versus estimated source and counter/reset scope; do not silently imply a fresh full pack.

toolbox: CFGBAT exposes no-power/minimum/critical/low/maximum thresholds and alert type.
aerodeck: Battery settings implement ordered validation, fixed/selected count and visual no-power/minimum/critical/low/max states, with verified SAVE/backup.
consequence: Functional threshold settings exist; they require a valid configured cell count.
ux: Show threshold scope and active count next to warnings; saving must retain validation/error feedback.

toolbox: RD/SND contains different low and critical tone/haptic patterns; main loop gates separate repeat windows and mute.
aerodeck: Sound/haptic/critical-only versus low+critical choices work; one generic1500Hz tone/haptic every10s for either severity, no separate patterns.
consequence: Alert options exist but do not match severity recognition/cadence in Toolbox.
ux: Use recognizable bounded low/critical patterns and a visible current alert/mute state.

toolbox: RD/BAT reads tx-voltage and radio threshold settings; DB1/RDB plus MOD/BAT show a separate radio battery gauge.
aerodeck: No tx-voltage read or radio-battery display anywhere in the full app; footer PACK is flight battery.
consequence: Long fullscreen use hides a core radio-health value shown by Toolbox.
ux: Separate RADIO from PACK; radio battery stays available while quad/receiver telemetry is absent.

toolbox: TBS/RL registers RFMD/TRSS/TQly/TSNR/TPWR/1RSS/2RSS/RQly/RSNR.
aerodeck: All these values sampled in27-field table; Link page shows key values and90-sample LQ trace. Valid/current values only.
consequence: Core numeric radio-link telemetry exists; presentation/decoding of mode is separate.
ux: Label uplink/downlink explicitly and keep antenna-specific readings distinguishable.

toolbox: TBS/RL has separate XF/TRS/EL2/EL3 RFMD tables and config protocol/version.
aerodeck: Displays raw numeric RFMD, with no protocol-version selection or verified packet-mode caption.
consequence: User cannot directly read250Hz or other mode names from AERODECK.
ux: Verified version-specific caption plus retained raw value; unknown mode remains numeric instead of a guessed rate.

toolbox: CFGRCL/TLMRLD change RSSI/RQLY defaults/ranges/units and row availability by protocol version; signal channels are interpreted separately.
aerodeck: RSSI/LQ/SNR low/critical values are editable and functional. Generic fixed defaults; no protocol/version adaptation or RSSI diversity policy.
consequence: Basic warnings work but changing profile does not carry Toolbox protocol semantics.
ux: Show units/source for each threshold, explain defaults, and preserve user changes when protocol changes.

toolbox: CFGIND chooses Timer1/2/3; DB1/TMR reads model.getTimer and displays running/countdown value.
aerodeck: No model.getTimer call/selector; only app-local radio-arm seconds in Arm Stops footer.
consequence: AERODECK does not show an existing EdgeTX flight/countdown timer.
ux: Read-only native timer selection first; expose running/countdown state without overwriting model timers.

toolbox: CFGIND selects OS/ToolBox host; original RD/TMR starts/stops/resets the chosen radio timer on arm transitions.
aerodeck: Local stopwatch increments while configured radioArm ON, caps any interval to1s, is reset on app reload and has no reset control/persistence.
consequence: A text stopwatch does not reproduce a managed/native timer; long callbacks can undercount.
ux: Choose explicit read-only/managed scope; preserve nonselected timers; deliberate session reset and accurate elapsed-time accounting.

toolbox: DB1/TIM draws date plus hour/minute.
aerodeck: Shell shows cached hour/minute and model name, not date. Independent of receiver telemetry.
consequence: Clock exists; full date/time presentation differs, a low-priority parity depth issue.
ux: Keep clock as status metadata; date can be optional and must not compete with flight readability.

toolbox: Original widget loader opens same Toolbox app in a full APP-size zone.
aerodeck: EdgeTX fullscreen refresh loads the same telem.lua/init/run as the tool; compact/hidden callback releases it.
consequence: The requested tool/fullscreen-widget path exists; lifecycle continuity is a separate row.
ux: Keep mappings and feature availability identical between tool and fullscreen widget; prevent duplicate clients.

toolbox: Original widget declares background callback guarded by APP.initDone then calls APP.G.ML.bg; earlier bytecode audit found M exposes G.initDone, so actual continuous hidden operation is unproven.
aerodeck: Explicitly stops/releases full app on compact/hidden refresh: no MSP, alerts, stopwatch or track acquisition continues there.
consequence: Do not claim Toolbox background parity or invent its behavior from callback presence; AERODECK foreground-only behavior is known.
ux: Decide and label foreground-only versus bounded session continuation; verify actual lifecycle on hardware before promising hidden monitoring.

toolbox: Reference loader reports Select APP mode layout outside full-size zone; no equivalent compact live panel is established by original source.
aerodeck: Adds compact voltage/current/LQ. It reads raw per-model config without main validation/.bak fallback, and uses unqualified sources.
consequence: Useful extra AERODECK capability, not a completed Toolbox parity item; compact may disagree after corruption/name collision.
ux: Share validated mappings/bindings with main app; keep useful compact panel, but exclude this addition from reference completion percentages.

toolbox: Original UI/QM T.mute toggles alert mute and updates action wording; SYS shows mute state.
aerodeck: No quick mute action or visible mute state; changing battery alert configuration is the only way to silence configured app alerts.
consequence: An in-session operational action has been replaced by deeper configuration.
ux: One action to mute/unmute with persistent icon; retain critical/low configuration values.

toolbox: Original QM stages timer/telemetry/sensor/GPS/VTX resets; scopes are real state mutations, not page navigation.
aerodeck: No session/new-flight reset action. Manual home sets only local home/track; histories/session and native extrema have no common reset path.
consequence: Between-pack data can mix sessions; user must close/reopen or use native menus.
ux: Explicit local-only/new-flight versus native timer/sensor reset scope; preserve model settings and make cancel atomic.

toolbox: Original QM Reload ToolBox queues reinitialization; CFGMDL queues runtime rebuilds after saves.
aerodeck: Refresh sensors rescans bindings/units, but no Reload app action; some startup changes say reopen. Normal RTN exits.
consequence: Source refresh exists; it does not rebuild the complete app or provide equivalent reload workflow.
ux: Separate Refresh sources from Reload application; retain saved settings and explain which state resets.

toolbox: CFGFNUI supports backup/restore and save hooks; model configuration is persisted separately.
aerodeck: Per-model cfg has working draft editing, SAVE/REVERT, validated readback and .bak fallback; hidden values persist.
consequence: Core local configuration persistence is implemented; functional coverage of individual controls is assessed separately.
ux: Keep explicit saved/unsaved/error feedback; migrate without resetting existing model preferences.

toolbox: Original CFGMDL enables battery/current/gyro/baro/pitot/GPS/VTX families and queues real init work; CFGUPDP hides categories/rows from actual features and protocol.
aerodeck: Twelve headings include notes/placeholders. Metadata hides lists, while sampler still reads all fixed fields; fcLink accepts RC protocol None and FC type None as auto. No true Off/Auto separation.
consequence: Twelve categories are not twelve functional equivalents; None does not have Toolbox OFF semantics.
ux: Separate Auto from Off and show actual capability/dependency state; disabled features must change runtime work, not only visibility.
